SELECT "id", "product_name", "sku_id", "warehouse_id", "status", "planner_id", "on_hand", "reserved", "reorder_point", "safety_stock", "target_stock", "unit_cost", "last_counted_at", "next_review_at", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at", count(*) OVER() AS total_count
FROM {{table:stock_items}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (coalesce("product_name"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%')
  AND ($2::text = '' OR "status" = $2::text)
  AND (NULLIF($7::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($7::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($8::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($8::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))
ORDER BY CASE WHEN $5::text = 'product_name' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "product_name" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'product_name' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "product_name" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'on_hand' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "on_hand" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'on_hand' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "on_hand" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'reserved' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "reserved" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'reserved' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "reserved" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'reorder_point' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "reorder_point" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'reorder_point' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "reorder_point" END DESC, id DESC
LIMIT $4::int OFFSET ((($3::int - 1) * $4::int))

SELECT "id", "product_name", "sku_id", "warehouse_id", "status", "planner_id", "on_hand", "reserved", "reorder_point", "safety_stock", "target_stock", "unit_cost", "last_counted_at", "next_review_at", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"
FROM {{table:stock_items}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (coalesce("product_name"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%')
  AND ($2::text = '' OR "status" = $2::text)
  AND (NULLIF($3::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($3::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($4::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($4::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))
ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT 5000

SELECT "id", "product_name", "sku_id", "warehouse_id", "status", "planner_id", "on_hand", "reserved", "reorder_point", "safety_stock", "target_stock", "unit_cost", "last_counted_at", "next_review_at", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at" FROM {{table:stock_items}} WHERE id = $1::int AND deleted_at IS NULL

INSERT INTO {{table:stock_items}} ("product_name", "sku_id", "warehouse_id", "status", "planner_id", "on_hand", "reserved", "reorder_point", "safety_stock", "target_stock", "unit_cost", "last_counted_at", "next_review_at", created_at, updated_at)
VALUES ($1::text, $2::int, $3::int, $4::text, $5::int, $6::int, $7::int, $8::int, $9::int, $10::int, $11::numeric, $12::timestamptz, $13::date, now(), now())
RETURNING "id", "product_name", "sku_id", "warehouse_id", "status", "planner_id", "on_hand", "reserved", "reorder_point", "safety_stock", "target_stock", "unit_cost", "last_counted_at", "next_review_at", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"

UPDATE {{table:stock_items}}
SET "product_name" = $2::text, "sku_id" = $3::int, "warehouse_id" = $4::int, "status" = $5::text, "planner_id" = $6::int, "on_hand" = $7::int, "reserved" = $8::int, "reorder_point" = $9::int, "safety_stock" = $10::int, "target_stock" = $11::int, "unit_cost" = $12::numeric, "last_counted_at" = $13::timestamptz, "next_review_at" = $14::date, updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::int AND deleted_at IS NULL
RETURNING "id", "product_name", "sku_id", "warehouse_id", "status", "planner_id", "on_hand", "reserved", "reorder_point", "safety_stock", "target_stock", "unit_cost", "last_counted_at", "next_review_at", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"
UPDATE {{table:stock_items}} SET deleted_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING id
UPDATE {{table:stock_items}} SET deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL RETURNING id
SELECT id, "product_name"::text AS label FROM {{table:stock_items}} WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY "product_name" LIMIT 500
UPDATE {{table:stock_items}} SET "status" = $2::text, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::int RETURNING id, "status"
UPDATE {{table:stock_items}} SET "planner_id" = $2::int, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::int RETURNING id, "planner_id"

SELECT count(*)::int AS total, coalesce(sum("unit_cost"), 0)::numeric(14,2) AS total_value, coalesce(avg("unit_cost"), 0)::numeric(14,2) AS average_value, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'healthy')::int AS status_healthy, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'low')::int AS status_low, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'critical')::int AS status_critical, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'out_of_stock')::int AS status_out_of_stock, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'overstock')::int AS status_overstock
FROM {{table:stock_items}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (NULLIF($1::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($1::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($2::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($2::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at)::date AS day, count(*)::int AS count, coalesce(sum("unit_cost"), 0)::numeric(14,2) AS total
FROM {{table:stock_items}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND created_at >= coalesce(NULLIF($1::text, '')::date, now() - interval '90 days')
  AND created_at < (coalesce(NULLIF($2::text, '')::date, now()::date) + interval '1 day')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT "status" AS status, count(*)::int AS count FROM {{table:stock_items}} WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (NULLIF($1::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($1::text, '')::date) AND (NULLIF($2::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($2::text, '')::date + interval '1 day')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT "id", "product_name", "sku_id", "warehouse_id", "status", "planner_id", "on_hand", "reserved", "reorder_point", "safety_stock", "target_stock", "unit_cost", "last_counted_at", "next_review_at", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at" FROM {{table:stock_items}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND "last_counted_at" IS NOT NULL
  AND "last_counted_at" < now() - ($1::int || ' days')::interval
  AND "status" NOT IN ('')
ORDER BY "last_counted_at" ASC LIMIT 100
